info.title: FluxGate API
info.description:
Multi-tenant API gateway. Three surfaces: the proxy under /gateway/* (API key), the dashboard API (HttpOnly session cookie, role-based), and an internal alert endpoint (HMAC signature, called by ai-service). /health* and /metrics are operational; /metrics requires a bearer token only when METRICS_TOKEN is set.

Every response carries X-Request-Id (always generated server side) and X-Trace-Id. Dashboard routes (everything except /gateway) accept bodies up to 256 KiB (413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE) and send CORS headers for the configured origins with credentials. Unknown fields in request bodies are ignored, not rejected. Minimum role per operation is given by the `x-required-role` extension.

get.description: Process-responsive check only; never touches dependencies.

503 only when Postgres is down or the instance is draining for shutdown. Redis or Kafka being down yields 200 with status "degraded" (the gateway still serves traffic). Each dependency check times out after 1 s.
If METRICS_TOKEN is configured the request must send `Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>`; otherwise the endpoint is open. Production startup requires METRICS_TOKEN.

post.summary: Create a tenant and its first admin
post.description: The only unauthenticated way to create a user, and it always creates a new tenant. Throttled to 20 attempts per client IP per 15 minutes (sliding window; fails open if Redis is down). The 429 uses the machine code TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.

409.description: An account with this email already exists (USER_EXISTS)

post.summary: Log in and set the session cookie
post.description: Sets the HttpOnly `Fluxgate_session` cookie (JWT HS256, 24 h, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, Secure when COOKIE_SECURE is true or, by default, NODE_ENV=production). Throttled to 30 attempts per client IP per 15 minutes.

Set-Cookie.description: Fluxgate_session=<jwt>; Max-Age=86400; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict[; Secure]

post.description: No authentication required. Only clears the cookie client side; the JWT is not revoked and stays valid until it expires (24 h).

post.description: Authenticated by `X-FluxGate-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>` where v1 = HMAC-SHA256(INTERNAL_ALERT_SECRET, `${t}.${rawBody}`) as lowercase hex, with t within 300 s of server time. Idempotent per (tenantId, requestId): a duplicate returns 202 with created=false. 404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND is permanent (ai-service sends it to its DLQ). The anomaly and its webhook deliveries are stored in one transaction.

get.summary: Proxy GET to the tenant's upstream
get.description: `{path}` is `<routePrefix>/<rest>`: the first segment selects the tenant's route (see /admin/routes) and the rest plus the query string are appended to that route's targetUrl. Authenticated with a tenant API key. Order: auth, telemetry, rate limit, proxy. The upstream response (status, headers, body) is streamed back unchanged except hop-by-hop headers, Server and X-Powered-By. The API key and the Fluxgate_session cookie are not forwarded; send upstream credentials in X-Upstream-Authorization and they arrive as Authorization. Redirects are not followed. In the app this is the single wildcard route `/gateway/*`, which matches any depth. The gateway adds no CORS headers and OPTIONS also requires the API key.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Route prefix and remaining path, e.g. `users/42`. May contain slashes.

parameters.name: X-Upstream-Authorization
parameters.description: Forwarded to the upstream as Authorization.

200.description: Upstream response. Any upstream status is passed through (this entry stands for all of them). Rate-limit headers are added.

X-RateLimit-Fallback.description: `fail-open`, sent instead of the three headers above, when Redis was unavailable and the request was let through unmetered.

404.description: No route configured for the prefix (error "Not Found"). An upstream 404 is also passed through.

X-RateLimit-Fallback.description: `fail-open`, sent instead of the three headers above, when Redis was unavailable and the request was let through unmetered.

502.description: Upstream unreachable, or target blocked by the SSRF guard

post.description: Sent as application/json to the endpoint URL. The signature is computed per attempt, so t changes between retries while the delivery id stays the same. Failed attempts are retried with exponential backoff (WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS, WEBHOOK_BACKOFF_MS, jittered); after the last attempt, or immediately for a disabled endpoint or a private-address target, the delivery is marked dead and can be retried via POST /webhooks/deliveries/{id}/retry. Redirects are not followed; the timeout is WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS.

parameters.name: X-FluxGate-Signature
parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`; v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, `${t}.${rawBody}`), where secret is the whsec_ string returned when the endpoint was created and rawBody is the exact request bytes. Recompute, compare in constant time, and reject if |now - t| > 300 s.

2XX.description: Acknowledge. Any other status, or a timeout, counts as a failed attempt.

sessionCookie.name: Fluxgate_session
sessionCookie.description: JWT (HS256) in an HttpOnly cookie set by POST /auth/login. Role and tenant are re-read from the database on every request. A missing, invalid or expired token, or a deleted user, gives 401.

apiKey.description: Tenant API key from POST /keys, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Used only on /gateway/*.

internalSignature.name: X-FluxGate-Signature
internalSignature.description: `t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>">` keyed by INTERNAL_ALERT_SECRET; 300 s tolerance.

E400.description: Invalid JSON (INVALID_JSON) or body failed validation (VALIDATION_ERROR; message is `<path>: <reason>` for the first issue), or UNSAFE_TARGET_URL

E401.description: No session cookie, invalid/expired token, or user no longer exists. error is "Unauthorized"; no requestId.

E403.description: Role below x-required-role. error is "Forbidden"; no requestId.

E404.description: Resource not found, or the id is not a UUID (same response)

Error.description: Produced by the error handler. `error` is a machine code such as VALIDATION_ERROR. Unknown routes return the same plus a `path` field.

ErrorBasic.description: Inline error from middleware; no requestId (use the X-Request-Id header). `error` is a title-case string such as Unauthorized or Forbidden, except PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.

plan.description: free, pro or enterprise by convention (default free); not constrained in the database

hint.description: Non-secret fragment for recognising the key

expiresInDays.description: Omit for a key that never expires

apiKey.description: Raw API key. Shown once; not recoverable.

pathPrefix.description: Single segment with a leading slash, e.g. /users

PathPrefix.description: Trimmed, a single path segment. A missing leading slash is added and a trailing slash removed (stored as /segment).

TargetUrl.description: http or https, no credentials, must not resolve to a private address

detectedAt.description: ISO 8601; a UTC offset is allowed

AnomalyWebhookData.description: The alert as received plus the stored anomaly id. alertType is delivered here although it is not stored on the anomaly.

id.description: Delivery id; stable across retries, use it to de-duplicate

createdAt.description: When the delivery row was created

name.description: "Unknown key" if the key row no longer exists
